# What the Build basemap workflow extracts and uploads. Edit and commit to run it.
# No credentials to create: the upload goes through the fulfilment worker with the
# ETCH_UPLOAD_TOKEN the repo already holds.
#
# REBUILDS go to a fresh dated key (key=basemap-YYYYMMDD.pmtiles) and then BASEMAP_KEY moves in
# fulfilment/wrangler.toml — the tile cache treats an archive as immutable under its key.
#
# bbox is min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat. Start with your market, verify a print end to end,
# then widen. Rough archive sizes at maxzoom 15: a metro ~200 MB, a state 1–3 GB, the western
# US ~15 GB (near a hosted runner's disk ceiling — widen in steps and watch the run's numbers).
#
# The default below is Arizona plus a margin, which covers every activity in the current
# library and is small enough to build in minutes.

bbox=-115.1,31.2,-108.8,37.2
maxzoom=15
key=basemap.pmtiles
